name: Charger
description:
You have experience rushing your enemies head on, granting the following benefits:
- When you use your Major Action to Dash, you can use a Minor Action to make a melee weapon attack or unarmed strike.
- If you move at least 10 ft. in a straight line before making a melee weapon attack or unarmed strike, you may gain a +5 bonus to the attack's To Hit or damage roll. You choose this after rolling but before knowing the outcome of the attack.
